snippet.title: Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune - Demo Trailer | New Date: Jan 29, 2026
snippet.description:
Support us with a wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423280/Pirates_Rogues_Fortune
NEW DATE: Demo available January 29, 2026 on Steam for PC and Steam Deck.
Full release coming early 2026.

Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune is a fast-paced pirate roguelite action-adventure set in the Caribbean. Dive for treasure, fight intense naval battles, and upgrade your ship to become the greatest pirate, run after run.

Thank you for your support, it means a lot to us!
